title: Catalog page with a hero
when: A catalog that opens with a campaign or a brand image.
evidence: a banner before the catalog grid on about 1 in 5 catalog pages

steps.note: Captions over the image only with the darkening on or dark photos.
Bestsellers under the tiles: the catalog then shows products, not only a way to them. The home hero's button leads to a collection page, not to /catalog.

The store-wide subscription keeps the preset chosen on home: `section set` restyles it on every page. Only where it already sits on this page: `section add` makes an independent copy, not the shared one.
